logic.event: At every UTC hour quarter-hour boundary minute (minute-of-hour in {0,15,30,45}) plus fixed phase_offset_minutes, start one long-only spot holding window of hold_minutes. Entry is at that minute open; exit at the open exactly hold_minutes later. Windows never overlap because hold_minutes<=3 and event spacing is 15 minutes. At each entry, use available account cash; no leverage, no cross-event open position, no transfers.
logic.causality: The deterministic UTC schedule is known before the event. Treat event signal as available 60 seconds before entry; execution is the actual next one-minute open at the event timestamp. Exit is scheduled at the next open after the fixed holding window. No candle close from the entry or holding window is used to decide entry.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT unlevered spot account per asset/parameter set; cash compounds between non-overlapping event windows; all positions liquidated by the scheduled exit, no interest.

logic.event: At every UTC hour quarter-hour boundary minute {0,15,30,45} plus fixed phase offset p, buy at that one-minute open and exit exactly hold_minutes later. Event windows do not overlap because hold_minutes<=3 and the next event is 15 minutes later. Repeat on the calendar only while sufficient cash and exchange filters permit.
logic.causality: UTC event timing is fixed and known in advance; the event signal is available 60 seconds before the first executable open. No entry or holding-period bar is used to select the event.
logic.sizing: Independent 5000 USDT unlevered long-only spot account per asset/config; use available cash at each permitted event; no transfers, leverage, shorts, interest or scale-in.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete UTC daily quote ADV)
parameters.exchange_filters: Frozen Binance exchange-info PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL; adverse tick rounding, lot floor and 5-minute pre-execution VWAP percent-price proxy.
